name: Lie
source:
A famous idol in the digital world, and the digital avatar of Kotone.
[spoiler]She appears to be a (close to) independent personality inside Kotone, created from her low self-esteem.They are shown to communicate via a small hand mirror Kotone carries around with herself.[/spoiler]
